title: Strategic Optimization of Bus Systems with Stochastic Ridership
abstract: arXiv:2610.01264v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In global metropolitan areas, public transport benefits from bus systems. Bus design widely applies theoretical models, which typically assume static ridership. However, ridership randomness exists, and lack of attention to it might lead to wrong design decisions. Moving beyond static ridership, we extend the traditional single-line model with stochastic ridership. Further, to optimize the bus system under various ridership randomness, we introduce a hybrid model that combines conventional buses (CBs) and flexible buses (FBs). In both models, we apply a continuous approximation approach and find that: 1) Bus capacity increases with ridership randomness in the extended single-line model; 2) The hybrid model exhibits a binary state: either CBs serve the ridership with rejections under low ridership randomness, or CBs serve the majority while FBs serve the minority with rejections under high ridership randomness. translated_title: 具有随机客流的公交系统战略优化
translated_abstract: 在全球大都市地区，公共交通受益于公交系统。公交设计广泛应用理论模型，这些模型通常假设客流量是静态的。然而，客流随机性客观存在，忽视这一点可能导致错误的设计决策。超越静态客流假设，我们将传统的单线路模型扩展为具有随机客流的模型。此外，为了在各种客流随机性下优化公交系统，我们引入了一个结合常规公交（CBs）和灵活公交（FBs）的混合模型。在这两个模型中，我们应用连续近似方法并发现：1）在扩展的单线路模型中，公交容量随客流随机性的增加而增加；2）混合模型呈现出二元状态：在低客流随机性下，由常规公交服务客流并存在拒载；在高客流随机性下，由常规公交服务大多数乘客，而灵活公交服务少数被拒载的乘客。我们的发现建立了一个……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文突破静态客流假设，将传统单线路公交模型扩展为随机客流模型，并提出结合常规公交与灵活公交的混合优化模型，发现公交容量随客流随机性增加而增加，且混合模型呈现二元服务状态。
en_tdlr: Moving beyond static ridership assumptions, this paper extends the traditional single-line bus model to incorporate stochastic ridership and introduces a hybrid model combining conventional and flexible buses, revealing that bus capacity increases with ridership randomness and the hybrid model exhibits a binary service state.
